answer_1.quote: Building systems that can comprehend human speech and provide assistance to humans through conversations is one of the main objectives in AI. Asking questions during a conversation is a crucial conversational behavior that helps AI agents communicate with humans more effectively.

answer_2.quote: We utilise BERTScore as our dialog entailment metric (BERTScore-entailment)... To measure the relevance between the generated conversation and the context, we concatenate the generated QA pairs and compute the BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: We hire three annotators who are English native speakers. Each generated question is rated by annotators on a 1-3 scale (3 is the best).
answer_4.guideline: We follow to utilize three criteria: (1) Factuality measures the factual correctness and meaning of generated questions, (2) Conversational Alignment measures how aligned the generated questions are with the history, (3) Answerability measures how answerable the generated questions are by the given context.
